citations.source: 李學勤主編《字源》；學(学) entry credited to 張標
citations.field: PDF p. 277, printed p. 265; headword discussion and entry boundary
citations.text: Directly inspected the supplied full-page scan. Under 學(学), the entry states “本义是学习、效法,” proposing learning and emulation/following as a model as the original meaning. It reports learning, school, instruction and other uses, but these reports do not establish a complete semantic chronology. The entry ends with 張標’s credit on printed p. 265; PDF p. 278 (printed p. 266) continues a separate 斆 entry, not 學. Edition: 2012, 天津古籍出版社 / 辽宁人民出版社, ISBN 978-7-5528-0069-2. I inspected the page pixels; decoded RGB pixel SHA-256: d71826450bb411b40d34cabacceaf5870e0eac285824128d9ab27b5d5dcd777f.

citations.source: 李學勤主編《字源》；學(学) entry credited to 張標
citations.field: PDF p. 277, printed p. 265; formation discussion, verified against full page and supplied crop
citations.text: The printed passage distinguishes proposals. One rare printed form is read jù and described as “两手或两爪之象” (two hands or claws); the glyph is not safely identifiable as a Unicode character. The next proposal is separate: “或从两臼（毚片）从冖，[臼]亦声（两臼或省作人形）,” involving two 臼 forms with 冖. Thus the scan supports a rare jù element and a separate two-臼 proposal; it does not gloss the rare graph as 踞 or identify it as 臼. The adjacent crop contains the target line and distinguishing text. Edition: 2012, ISBN 978-7-5528-0069-2; full-page decoded RGB pixel SHA-256 d71826450bb411b40d34cabacceaf5870e0eac285824128d9ab27b5d5dcd777f; crop pixel SHA-256 8e9874740d3c732548c3c880fd7867ad93dd10cf0a4d8d2bc7c5c87f938c194f.
